summary: Backend-only testing for Fresh Start Property Care booking APIs. Created /app/backend/tests/test_bookings.py with 16 pytest test cases covering all CRUD operations and validation paths against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 16 tests passed (100% success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses MongoDB ObjectId as booking id which is fine, but the codebase elsewhere uses uuid (StatusCheck). Consider standardising on one identifier strategy.

BookingUpdate model only validates status as string; the explicit enum check in the handler works but moving to a Pydantic Literal/Enum (e.g. Literal['pending','approved','completed','declined']) would automate the 422 vs 400 distinction and keep validation in the schema layer.

create_booking stores datetime objects directly into Mongo (timezone-aware) and booking_helper returns them as-is, while StatusCheck endpoint stores ISO strings. Inconsistency in datetime serialization across collections; clients receive datetime as ISO string in JSON (FastAPI), so OK functionally, but pick one pattern.
GET /api/bookings silently ignores invalid status query values (returns all). Consider returning 400 for unknown status values to surface client bugs.
to_list(1000) hard caps results; add pagination (skip/limit) before this scales.
No auth on admin PATCH/DELETE endpoints — anyone with the URL can approve/decline/delete bookings. HIGH severity for production, though out of scope for this MVP test request.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; switch to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own bookings prefixed with TEST_ via a session-scoped fixture that DELETEs all tracked ids after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend booking endpoints fully covered and passing. Frontend was not tested in this iteration. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bookings.py — invoke with `pytest backend/tests/test_bookings.py -v`. Note: no auth on admin endpoints; flag for E1 to add before production but not blocking current MVP.
